origin:
Century Motorsport's story began in the late 1990s in a small workshop nestled in the Oxfordshire countryside. Founded by childhood friends, James Thornton and David Green, the team was initially a weekend hobby fueled by a shared passion for club racing. Their early efforts involved painstakingly rebuilding a discarded BMW 325i, scavenging parts from local scrapyards, and learning the ropes of race preparation through trial and error. The first few seasons were a mix of mechanical failures and modest successes, but the unwavering dedication and camaraderie within the team laid the foundation for future growth. A pivotal moment came in 2005 when a local businessman, impressed by their grit and potential, offered a small sponsorship deal, allowing them to upgrade their equipment and compete in a higher-level series.

From those humble beginnings, Century Motorsport gradually evolved from a pure amateur outfit into a respected competitor in various national GT and endurance racing championships. The team's ethos remained rooted in its early days, prioritizing teamwork, resourcefulness, and a commitment to developing young talent. While they may never have had the biggest budgets or flashiest facilities, Century Motorsport consistently punched above its weight, earning a reputation for reliability and strategic acumen.
philosophy: Century Motorsport's racing philosophy centers around maximizing performance within their means. They prioritize meticulous preparation and data analysis over extravagant spending, focusing on optimizing the car's setup and driver performance. The team culture is built on open communication, mutual respect, and a shared commitment to continuous improvement. They pride themselves on fostering a supportive environment where young drivers and engineers can learn and grow, often giving promising rookies their first opportunity in competitive motorsport.
achievements: 2015: British GT Championship - Silverstone 500 - Class Win
2018: Radical Challenge Championship - Selected Race Wins
2020: Ginetta GT4 SuperCup - Multiple Podium Finishes

teamPrincipal.name: James Thornton
teamPrincipal.background: James Thornton is one of the original founders of Century Motorsport. He has a deep understanding of motorsport mechanics and a hands-on leadership style, often found in the garage alongside the mechanics.

keyFigures.name: David Green
keyFigures.description: David Green, the other co-founder, is the team's technical mastermind. He oversees all aspects of car development and engineering, bringing a meticulous and analytical approach to the team's technical challenges.

headquarters: Century Motorsport operates from a modest industrial unit on the outskirts of Witney, Oxfordshire. The facilities are functional but basic, comprising a workshop, engine room, and office space. While not state-of-the-art, the team makes the most of its resources, focusing on efficient organization and clever engineering solutions.
fanBase: Century Motorsport has a small but loyal fanbase, primarily consisting of local racing enthusiasts and family members of team members. They are known for their unwavering support and appreciation of the team's underdog spirit, often seen cheering them on at race meetings across the UK.
